title: Group privacy
summary: Who can join a group, what older messages a new member sees, and the requests to join (bipe-chat/bipe#772). Opens from the row bipe_group_privacy_title in group-details, for members who can change the join rule.

join.description: Under bipe_group_privacy_join. invite: bipe_group_privacy_join_invite, JoinRule invite (the default of group-create). knock: bipe_group_privacy_join_knock, JoinRule knock. Another rule set by another client shows no choice selected.

history.description: Under bipe_group_privacy_history, with bipe_group_privacy_history_footer. joined: bipe_group_privacy_history_joined, RoomHistoryVisibility joined (default). shared: bipe_group_privacy_history_shared, RoomHistoryVisibility shared.

requests.description: Under bipe_group_requests, from Room.subscribeToKnockRequests. Hidden when empty. Each row has bipe_group_request_accept and bipe_group_request_decline when the member can invite.

publicationOnly.description: bipe_group_publication_only_title, a switch with bipe_group_publication_only_footer. True when the room state event publicationOnly.stateEvent of registries/group-power-levels.json has enabled exactly true. The SDK has no call for a custom state event, so the app reads GET /_matrix/client/v3/rooms/{roomId}/state.

canChangePublicationOnly.description: RoomPowerLevels.canOwnUserSendState for m.room.power_levels. The event has no entry in the group's power levels, so stateDefault sets who can send it: an admin in a new group.

publicFeedHandle.description: Empty when none. bipe-chat/bipe#1260, ADR 0280 point 7c. The handle of GET /v1/me/feed when its room_id is this group, else empty and no row. Shows bipe_group_public_feed_title (with the handle) and a switch with bipe_group_public_feed_footer. Only the handle owner sees it, and only after staff linked the feed (Public Canal gate closed).

publicFeedEnabled.description: enabled of GET /v1/me/feed, the switch value.

setJoin.effect: Room.updateJoinRules. A failure shows bipe_error_generic and keeps the old choice.

setPublicationOnly.effect: Room.sendStateEventRaw with publicationOnly.stateEvent, state key empty, content {"enabled": true or false}. A failure shows bipe_error_generic and keeps the old value.

setPublicFeed.effect: PUT /v1/me/feed. Off takes the page down and stops new posts; on brings it back. A failure shows bipe_error_generic and keeps the old value.

accept.effect: KnockRequestActions.accept: the person is invited and can join.

notes: Encryption stays on and is not a choice (security rule 13).

Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#772): no "anyone with the link" choice and no room address, because under ADR 0179 join rule public makes a room plain text, and public rooms are the curated open groups of ADR 0182 (bipe-chat/bipe#749). mz can overrule.
A person with the group link (room-link-open) sees bipe_app_room_link_knock when the rule is knock.

Publication-only (ADR 0280 point 7b, bipe-chat/bipe#1263): an existing group can turn this on and off, and the group stays encrypted and private. It does not make the group public. bipe-infra compose/synapse-modules/bipe_messaging.py enforces it on the server.
